evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs and modifies utility file handling code in src/util/fs_helpers.cpp.
rationale: Prevents AllocateFileRange from zero-overwriting or truncating block files during -reindex on Windows and platforms lacking posix_fallocate. As documented in issue #33128, the fallback implementation silently wipes block data in blk*.dat files during reindex, leaving only the genesis block recovered.
